claims.nodeLabel: Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP)
claims.text: DIRD inside covers name the program 'Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program' and reference an 'AAWSA Program Manager, Defense Intelligence Agency, ATTN: [redacted], Bldg 6000, Washington, DC 20340-5100'. The program manager's name is redacted under (b)(3) 10 USC 424 and (b)(6) throughout the release.

DIRD DIA-08-1004-004, 'Traversable Wormholes, Stargates, and Negative Energy', Acquisition Threat Support series, 6 April 2010, ICOD 1 December 2009, exists in the DIA FOIA release with the author withheld under (b)(6).

Attribution of these two DIRDs to Eric W. Davis is not established by the DIA release (author redacted). It rests on Davis's own account and secondary reporting. Wave-4 item: locate a primary record naming him (e.g. an unredacted copy, a subcontract, or sworn testimony).

Every released DIRD carries the line: 'Comments or questions pertaining to this document should be addressed to [name redacted under (b)(3) 10 USC 424 and (b)(6)], AAWSA Program Manager, Defense Intelligence Agency, ATTN: [redacted], Bldg 6000, Washington, DC 20340-5100.' The AAWSAP program manager post is therefore documented in primary record; the incumbent's name is withheld in the DIA release.

The DIRDs fall into two DIA series banners printed on the cover: 'Acquisition Threat Support' (the FY2009 tranche, ICOD 1 December 2009, published Dec 2009 - Apr 2010) and 'Defense Futures' (the FY2010 tranche, ICOD Jul-Dec 2010, published Nov 2010 - Jan 2011).
